text:
Ana M.: Quick heads-up — HW partner sent Q4 supply numbers and a spot-floor guideline. Need to fold into marketplace onboarding + reserved pricing forecast. Can we get a short mapping to our cost model by EOD?

Ben K.: Do we have the raw CSV? link?

Carmen L.: Uploaded to the partnerships drive: https://rwd-infer/drive/q4-hw-supply.csv — summary below. Key points: 1) Reserved commit windows: 1/3/12 months; 2) Spot availability expected to be 25-40% of pool; 3) Per-hour list price varies by region (US-west cheaper).

Rahul P.: Quick ask — what SKU granularity are they giving? per-GPU, per-node, or per-pool? We need per-GPU for autoscaling cost sims.

Carmen L.: They gave per-node + an allocation table mapping node->gpu_count. For modeling I converted to per-GPU. sample snippet:
```
node_type,gpus,reserved_avail_pct,spot_avail_pct,base_hourly_usd
nv4-16,8,60,30,2.50
nv4-32,16,70,25,4.80
```

Sophie F.: Important — Marketplace takes a 10% listing fee on top of partner list; also trade discounts for 12mo reserves. Need to include fee layering in net unit economics.

Marco T.: For forecasting: assume spot usable fraction = spot_avail_pct * 0.85 (we lose some to churn/preempt). Also recommend applying a 5% safety haircut on reserved availability for failure/maintenance.

Ben K.: Noted. Carmen, can you confirm commit lead times? if partners require 30d lead for reserved allocation we can't short-cycle commit.

Carmen L.: Lead times: 14-45 days depending on vendor and region. They flagged AZ1 (eu-west-2) as 45d for large reserved blocks.

Rahul P.: For pricing model inputs I need: per-GPU base cost, spot discount %, commit discount by tenor, lead time, and max alloc per-customer. Can you populate a row per region+node?

Carmen L.: I'll push that. Example of commit discounts they provided: 1mo=0%,3mo=8%,12mo=22%. Spot typically priced at base * 0.35-0.55 depending on region.

Sophie F.: Also include optional marketplace promo credit — some partners will co-fund first-month reserved credits (up to 15% of reserved spend) if we commit to a joint listing announcement. That changes payback timing.

Ana M.: Important for product: if we plan a joint announcement we should lock a small commit to get the promo credit and better listing placement. Add a boolean flag in the sheet for "cofund_promo".

Marco T.: Modeling note: When mapping to our batching and multi-tenant capacity pool, convert per-GPU hourly to per-token cost using expected qps and tokens/s for target models. Quick rule-of-thumb I used earlier: 1 x A100-equivalent GPU at 8k context serving mix => ~0.0009 USD/token (very rough).

Ben K.: Can we get a short sensitivity row that shows reserved vs spot mix effect on unit cost +/- 10%? That helps pricing dev for marketplace SKUs.

Carmen L.: I will add sensitivity columns: reserved_pct, spot_pct, preempt_pct and a calculated net_unit_cost_usd. Will include marketplace fee and promo effect.

Rahul P.: One more — SLA tiers. Partners allow SLA-backed reserved pools (99.9) but not for spot. Need to flag which pools are eligible for SLA and which are best-effort.

Carmen L.: Marked in sheet: sla_eligible = true for reserved pools in region set A, false for ephemeral pools.

Sophie F.: Timeline check — Carmen, can you get the sheet updated and drop a final summary in this thread by 17:00 PT? We'll run numbers and propose pricing lanes (standard, commit-3mo, commit-12mo, spot-burst).

Carmen L.: Yep — I'll have the sheet and a 3-line summary by 16:30 PT.

Ana M.: Thanks. After Carmen posts I'll slot a 30min sync with finance + pricing to finalize marketplace SKU rates. If anyone can't make the sync, leave comments in the sheet. :thumbsup:

Marketplace Bot: New listing draft created for partner-xyz (draft-id: mkt-1229). Reminder: listing requires final unit price, SLA tag, and promo flag.

Ben K.: Perfect — once Carmen posts I'll run the sensitivity table and ping pricing eng.

Ana M.: Closing loop — goal is to have reserved/spot inputs merged into the cost model and draft marketplace SKUs by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all.
